preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of vertices n is between 2 and 2 * 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 for n, edges in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [input().split() for _ in range(sum([int(input().split()[0]) - 1 for _ in range(t)]))]))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(u) <= n and 1 <= int(v) <= n and u != v for u, v in edges) for n, edges in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [input().split() for _ in range(sum([int(input().split()[0]) - 1 for _ in range(t)]))]))
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(output) <= n for output, n in zip(stdout.split(), [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)]))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a single integer between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output) == min_leaves for output, min_leaves in zip(stdout.split(), [min_leaves_calculation(n, edges) for n, edges in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [input().split() for _ in range(sum([int(input().split()[0]) - 1 for _ in range(t)]))]))])
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is the minimum number of leaves possible after performing the allowed operations.
